lines: New intern at nine o'clock. Eyes like a deer on a highway.
Leave them alone. We were all deer once.
I was never a deer. I was born scrubbed in.
You were born late. Like every shift since.
Bed six wants a private room again.
Bed six wants a lot of things. Bed six can want.
Six hours. I could have died twice by now.
You've told me four times. You look very alive.
Aarav, put that down. That is not a sweet.
